correctness.rationale: Presentation-compatible generator pairs exhaust all endomorphisms. Composition idempotence leads to: CRT choices a^2=a and ab=0 for rotation–reflection pairs; forced parity choice for reflection-image pairs; one exceptional pair of central-involution maps exactly when n/2 odd; and the trivial map. Automorphisms r->r^u,s->r^v s act by b->ub+(1-a)v and c->uc+v, giving the stated complete orbit structure. Independent finite checks reconstruct every map and its orbit for n even 4..32; finite tests are supplemental, not a proof of the infinite family.

value.rationale: A full all-parameter classification of retract maps and their conjugacy types is a natural group-theoretic invariant. It refines unweighted homomorphism totals by exact image orders and symmetry orbit sizes; identifies the two independent reflection-retraction types; and isolates a sharp 2-adic central retraction bifurcation at n=2 mod 4. It describes all finite even dihedral groups, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
